_source.description: A stylish 6-bedroom apartment in the sought-after Libération area of Nice. Located on the first floor, this modern and contemporary residence has been designed with great attention to detail, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere enhanced by a refined and sophisticated design. The apartment features a bright and comfortable living space with an open kitchen. Six well-proportioned bedrooms provide both comfort and privacy, complemented by three bathrooms. Air conditioning throughout the apartment ensures a pleasant living environment year-round. Ideally situated in the vibrant Libération neighborhood, residents benefit from its lively market, cafés, shops, and excellent transport connections. Rent includes building charges, bi-monthly cleaning of common areas, internet/cable TV, water, and an electricity provision (adjusted annually). A one-time fee covers the lease, check-in/out, inventory, and ongoing assistance. APL eligible—see the CAF website for a personalized simulation.
_source.title: 16 Avenue Alfred Borriglione
